name: Anselm of Canterbury
contribution: A Benedictine abbot, philosopher and theologian who served as Archbishop of Canterbury from 1093 to 1109.
legacy: Despite his lack of recognition in this field in his own lifetime, this person is famously regarded as the originator of the ontological argument for the existence of God and of the satisfaction theory of atonement.

checks.lead: Anselm of Canterbury (; 1033/4–1109), also known as Anselm of Aosta (French: Anselme d'Aoste, Italian: Anselmo d'Aosta) after his birthplace and Anselm of Bec (French: Anselme du Bec) after his monastery, was a Benedictine abbot, philosopher and theologian who served as Archbishop of Canterbury from 1093 to 1109.
